caption: The drawing depicts a human figure, portrayed as Jesus, affixed to a cross. The cross is primarily black with horizontal and vertical beams, decorated with red, beige, and black alternating segments, and includes decorative patterns such as circles and semi-circles in red, yellow, and black. The figure has a tan skin tone, and red markings along the body indicating stylized wounds and muscles. The face has a dark beard and mustache, large eyes, and a closed mouth. A yellow halo with red, orange, and black rays surrounds the head. The figure wears a short, yellow garment around the waist, which features a circular pattern with black, red, and yellow elements. The arms are extended outward on the cross, the palms are open, and both hands and feet have red marks representing the wounds. The legs are depicted together, with red lines running down the shins representing blood. The background is plain and white with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Crucifix - From the Vicinity of Mora
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
